requirement.description: The KPI definition process is broken and has stopped working. That is simply the state of the system right now.
requirement.fact: The KPI definition process is broken and has stopped working.
requirement.reading: That is simply the state of the system right now.

narrator.name: Efficiency Emilia
narrator.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The KPI definition workflow is currently non functional. The automated validation step that used to check alignment between model features and business objectives stopped running after the last infrastructure migration. It has not been repaired since. Teams now bypass the system entirely. They define their own metrics in local spreadsheets and share them manually via email before quarterly reviews. There is no central registry. No one updates the shared dashboard. The process is effectively dormant, and everyone operates based on their own isolated definitions without any formal cross checking or approval from the central team.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state and history of the KPI workflow without expressing any specific wishes, refusals, or explicit trade-offs by the author.
